package bellica

// Regression tests for the self-audit fixes (AUDIT.md) and the gnoweb UX items.

import (
	"chain"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

// F4: batch disqualification, DQ'd agents cannot resubmit, reinstating frees
// the DQ counter, and the hard total cap holds.
func TestAudit_F4_DisqualifyManyAndCaps(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := newBounty(cur, 4_000_000, "60,40", false, judge.String())
	var list []string
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		a := testutils.TestAddress("r4s" + strconv.Itoa(i))
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(a))
		Register(cross(cur), "r4s"+strconv.Itoa(i), "", "")
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/s/s", "abcd1234", "", 1)
		list = append(list, a.String())
	}
	// only the judge, reason required, batch bounded
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the judge can do this", func() { DisqualifyMany(cross(cur), id, list[0], "spam spam") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "reason must be 3-280 characters", func() { DisqualifyMany(cross(cur), id, list[0], "\u202e  ") })
	big := strings.Repeat(list[0]+",", maxDQBatch) + list[1]
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "at most 50 agents per call", func() { DisqualifyMany(cross(cur), id, big, "spam spam") })
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, DisqualifyMany(cross(cur), id, strings.Join(list[:3], ", ")+",", "empty repo, spam"))
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, mustBounty(id).dqs)
	// DQ twice does not double count
	Disqualify(cross(cur), id, list[0], "still spam")
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, mustBounty(id).dqs)
	// a disqualified agent cannot resubmit while open
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(address(list[0])))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "your entry was disqualified: still spam", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/s/s", "abcd9999", "", 0)
	})
	// reinstating during judging decrements the counter
	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	ScoreEntry(cross(cur), id, list[1], 7)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, mustBounty(id).dqs)
	// judge window over: no more disqualifications
	minutes(61)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "judging window is over; use Fallback", func() { Disqualify(cross(cur), id, list[3], "late dq") })
}

// F4: the total cap (incl. disqualified entries) bounds Finalize/Fallback loops.
func TestAudit_F4_TotalCap(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", false, judge.String())
	b := mustBounty(id)
	for i := 0; i < maxEntriesPer; i++ {
		a := testutils.TestAddress("r4t" + strconv.Itoa(i))
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(a))
		Register(cross(cur), "t", "", "")
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/s/s", "abcd1234", "", 1)
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, maxEntriesPer, b.entries.Size())
	b.dqs = b.entries.Size() // as if the judge had DQ'd all 200: active slots free up, total cap remains
	for i := maxEntriesPer; i < maxEntriesTotal; i++ {
		a := testutils.TestAddress("r4t" + strconv.Itoa(i))
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(a))
		Register(cross(cur), "t", "", "")
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/s/s", "abcd1234", "", 1)
	}
	x := testutils.TestAddress("r4tx")
	register(cur, x, "x")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(x))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bounty is full", func() { Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/s/s", "abcd1234", "", 1) })
}

// F5: the leaderboard index stays in sync with Earned/Wins and has no stale keys.
func TestAudit_F5_LeaderboardIndex(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	p := testutils.TestAddress("r5p")
	q := testutils.TestAddress("r5q")
	register(cur, p, "r5-p")
	register(cur, q, "r5-q")
	before := competing
	id := newBounty(cur, 10_000_000, "70,30", true, judge.String())
	submit(cur, p, id, 10)
	submit(cur, q, id, 20)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+2, competing)
	submit(cur, q, id, 21) // resubmit does not double count
	uassert.Equal(t, before+2, competing)
	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id)
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, competing, board.Size()) // one key per competing agent
	// board order == earned desc, wins desc
	var prev *Agent
	board.Iterate("", "", func(_ string, v any) bool {
		a := v.(*Agent)
		if prev != nil {
			uassert.True(t, prev.Earned > a.Earned || (prev.Earned == a.Earned && prev.Wins >= a.Wins), "board out of order")
		}
		prev = a
		return false
	})
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("agents"), "r5-q"), Render("agents"))
	js := Render("json/agents")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Index(js, `"name":"r5-q"`) < strings.Index(js, `"name":"r5-p"`), js)
}

// F5: agent history and posted/judged come from per-address indexes.
func TestAudit_F5_AgentHistoryIndex(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	h := testutils.TestAddress("r5h")
	register(cur, h, "r5-h")
	register(cur, judge, "r5-judge")
	register(cur, creator, "r5-host")
	id := newBounty(cur, 2_000_000, "100", false, judge.String())
	submit(cur, h, id, 3)
	page := Render("agent/" + h.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "Contest history"), page)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, pl("bounty/"+itoa(id))), page)
	jp := Render("agent/" + judge.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(jp, "Posted / judged"), jp)
	cp := Render("agent/" + creator.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(cp, "| creator |"), cp)
}

// F5: json/bounties = open + newest closed (bounded); json/bounties/{page} pages all.
func TestAudit_F5_BountiesJSONPaging(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", false, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	id2 := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", false, "")
	all := Render("json/bounties")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(all, `"id":`+itoa(id)+`,`), all)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Index(all, `"id":`+itoa(id2)+`,`) < strings.Index(all, `"id":`+itoa(id)+`,`), "newest first")
	p1 := Render("json/bounties/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(p1, `[{"id":`+itoa(id2)+`,`), p1)
	uassert.Equal(t, `{"error":"bad page"}`, Render("json/bounties/0"))
	uassert.Equal(t, "[]", Render("json/bounties/999999"))
	_, isOpen := openBounties.Get(key(id)).(*Bounty)
	uassert.False(t, isOpen, "cancelled bounty left in the open index")
}

// UX (UX_REVIEW §7): internal links are absolute (gnoweb drops ":page" links),
// titles and agent names are links, and home has an "Enter a bounty" path.
func TestAudit_UX_LinksAndEnterButton(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	u := testutils.TestAddress("uxagent")
	register(cur, u, "ux-agent")
	id := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", false, judge.String())
	submit(cur, u, id, 9)
	pages := []string{"", "bounty/" + itoa(id), "agent/" + u.String(), "agents", "help", "stats", "nope"}
	for _, p := range pages {
		out := Render(p)
		uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(out, "](:"), "relative link on "+p)
	}
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, `label="🚀 Enter a bounty"`), home)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, pl("bounty/"+itoa(newestEnterable()))), home)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "[ux-agent]("+pl("agent/"+u.String())+")"), home) // leader cell is a link
	bp := Render("bounty/" + itoa(id))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(bp, "[ux-agent]("+pl("agent/"+u.String())+")"), bp)
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(pl("help"), "/r/"), pl("help"))
}

func newestEnterable() int { return enterable().ID }

// F1: every input path is cleaned (titles, URLs, notes, reasons, judge).
func TestAudit_F1_AllInputsCleaned(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	c := testutils.TestAddress("r1c")
	register(cur, c, "r1-c")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	id := newBountyTitled(cur, "Spoof\u202e title\u200b", " "+judge.String()+"\u200f ")
	b := mustBounty(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Spoof title", b.Title)
	uassert.Equal(t, judge, b.Judge)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(c))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/c/c\u202e", "abcd1234\u2066", "note\u202e\x07", 1)
	e := b.entries.Get(c.String()).(*Entry)
	uassert.Equal(t, "https://github.com/c/c", e.RepoURL)
	uassert.Equal(t, "abcd1234", e.Commit)
	uassert.Equal(t, "note", e.Note)
	// a line break smuggled as U+2028 is still rejected
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "note must be a single line", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/c/c", "abcd1234", "a\u2028b", 1)
	})
}

func newBountyTitled(cur realm, title, judgeAddr string) int {
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, coins(1_000_000))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins(1_000_000))
	id := CreateBounty(cross(cur), title, "", "ms", false, "100", 60, 60, judgeAddr, "", 0)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	return id
}

func coins(n int64) chain.Coins { return chain.Coins{{"ugnot", n}} }

// FP check (double pay): once closed, no door reopens; each close path runs once.
func TestAudit_FP_NoDoubleClose(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	w := testutils.TestAddress("fpw")
	register(cur, w, "fp-w")
	id := newBounty(cur, 2_000_000, "100", false, judge.String())
	submit(cur, w, id, 1)
	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id)
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	paid := mustBounty(id).Paid
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bounty is not in judging (wait for the deadline)", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bounty is closed", func() { Disqualify(cross(cur), id, w.String(), "late dq") })
	minutes(200)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "fallback only after the judging window, on an unfinalized bounty", func() { Fallback(cross(cur), id) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "cannot cancel: bounty has entries or is closed", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.Equal(t, paid, mustBounty(id).Paid)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_000_000), paid)
}

package bellica

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

var (
	pkgAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1ac3v8vr4ddr2m7g68gkksz3f463v9x95w05pnl/bellica")
	creator = testutils.TestAddress("creator")
	judge   = testutils.TestAddress("judge")
	alice   = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob     = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol   = testutils.TestAddress("carol")
	dave    = testutils.TestAddress("dave")
)

func minutes(n int64) { testing.SkipHeights(n * 12) } // 5s blocks

func bal(cur realm, a address) int64 {
	return int64(banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoins(a).AmountOf("ugnot"))
}

func newBounty(cur realm, pot int64, splits string, higher bool, judgeAddr string) int {
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{"ugnot", pot}})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", pot}})
	id := CreateBounty(cross(cur), "Fastest JSON parser", "https://example.com/spec", "ms per op", higher, splits, 60, 60, judgeAddr, "", 0)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	return id
}

func register(cur realm, a address, name string) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(a))
	Register(cross(cur), name, "https://example.com/"+name+"/agent.json", "an agent")
}

func TestRankedPayout(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	for _, a := range []address{alice, bob, carol, dave} {
		register(cur, a, strings.ToUpper(a.String()[:4]))
	}
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 10_000_000, "50,30,20", false, judge.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, "open", Phase(id))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/a/p", "abc1234", "simd", 120)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/b/p", "def5678", "", 90)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/c/p", "aaa0001", "", 150)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/d/p", "bbb0002", "", 10)

	// judge cannot act before the deadline
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bounty is not in judging (wait for the deadline)", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })

	minutes(61)
	uassert.Equal(t, "judging", Phase(id))
	// late submissions are rejected
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "submissions are closed", func() { Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/b/p", "zzz9999", "", 1) })
	// only the judge can score
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the judge can do this", func() { ScoreEntry(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), 1) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	n := AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, 4, n)
	ScoreEntry(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), 95) // judge re-measured bob
	Disqualify(cross(cur), id, dave.String(), "10ms not reproducible") // dave's 10ms not reproducible

	before := bal(cur, creator)
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, "paid", Phase(id))

	// lower is better: bob 95 (1st), alice 120 (2nd), carol 150 (3rd)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), bal(cur, bob))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_000_000), bal(cur, alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_000_000), bal(cur, carol))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), bal(cur, dave))
	uassert.Equal(t, before, bal(cur, creator))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, agentOf(bob).Wins)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_000_000), agentOf(alice).Earned)

	out := Render("bounty/" + itoa(id))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "🥇 1st"), out)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(out, "🚫 DQ"), out)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render(""), "Fastest JSON parser"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(BountyJSON(id), `"phase":"paid"`))

	// cannot finalize twice
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "bounty is not in judging (wait for the deadline)", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })
}

func TestUnfilledPlacesGoToCompetitors(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 3_000_001, "50,30,20", true, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/a/q", "c0ffee1", "", 7)
	minutes(61)
	before := bal(cur, creator)
	beforeAlice := bal(cur, alice)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator)) // creator judges when judge is empty
	AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id)
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	// only one place filled: the whole pot goes to alice, nothing back to the creator
	uassert.Equal(t, beforeAlice+3_000_001, bal(cur, alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, before, bal(cur, creator))
}

func TestFallbackWhenJudgeSilent(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	register(cur, bob, "bob-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 2_000_001, "100", true, judge.String())
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/a/r", "1111111", "", 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/b/r", "2222222", "", 2)

	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "fallback only after the judging window, on an unfinalized bounty", func() { Fallback(cross(cur), id) })
	minutes(61)
	uassert.Equal(t, "awaiting-fallback", Phase(id))
	// judge is too late now
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "judging window is over; use Fallback", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })

	a0, b0 := bal(cur, alice), bal(cur, bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol)) // anyone can trigger it
	Fallback(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, a0+1_000_001, bal(cur, alice)) // first submitter gets the dust
	uassert.Equal(t, b0+1_000_000, bal(cur, bob))
	uassert.Equal(t, "fallback", Phase(id))
}

func TestCancelAndRules(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "60,40", true, "")
	// non-creator cannot cancel
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the creator can cancel", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	// creator cannot enter own bounty
	register(cur, creator, "creator-bot")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "creator and judge cannot compete in their own bounty", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/x/y", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	})
	before := bal(cur, creator)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, before+1_000_000, bal(cur, creator))
	uassert.Equal(t, "cancelled", Phase(id))

	// unregistered agents cannot submit
	id2 := newBounty(cur, 1_000_000, "100", true, "")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(testutils.TestAddress("stranger")))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "register your agent first (Register)", func() {
		Submit(cross(cur), id2, "https://github.com/x/y", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	})
	// creator cannot cancel once an entry exists
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Submit(cross(cur), id2, "https://github.com/a/z", "abcdef0", "", 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(creator))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "cannot cancel: bounty has entries or is closed", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id2) })
}

func TestValidation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "1.5 GNOT", gnot(1_500_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "2 GNOT", gnot(2_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, `\[x\]\(javascript:\)`, esc("[x](javascript:)"))
	uassert.Equal(t, `evil\]\(x\)`, link("evil](x)"))
}

func itoa(i int) string {
	return strings.TrimLeft(key(i), "0")
}

// submit is a helper: agent a enters bounty id with a claimed score.
func submit(cur realm, a address, id int, score int64) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(a))
	Submit(cross(cur), id, "https://github.com/x/"+a.String()[:6], "abc1234", "", score)
}


func TestTieBreakAndResubmit(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	register(cur, bob, "bob-bot")
	register(cur, carol, "carol-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 10_000_000, "70,30", true, judge.String())
	submit(cur, alice, id, 50)
	submit(cur, bob, id, 50)
	submit(cur, carol, id, 50)
	submit(cur, alice, id, 50) // alice resubmits: loses the tie-break edge
	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id)
	a0, b0, c0 := bal(cur, alice), bal(cur, bob), bal(cur, carol)
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	// all tied at 50: order is bob, carol, alice
	uassert.Equal(t, b0+7_000_000, bal(cur, bob))
	uassert.Equal(t, c0+3_000_000, bal(cur, carol))
	uassert.Equal(t, a0, bal(cur, alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, mustEntry(mustBounty(id), alice.String()).Rank)
}

func TestFinalizeNeedsEveryEntryJudged(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")
	register(cur, bob, "bob-bot")
	id := newBounty(cur, 2_000_000, "100", false, judge.String())
	submit(cur, alice, id, 10)
	submit(cur, bob, id, 20)
	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(judge))
	ScoreEntry(cross(cur), id, alice.String(), 11)
	// the judge cannot just skip bob
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "score or disqualify every entry before Finalize (AcceptClaimed scores the rest)", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })
	// a reason is mandatory to disqualify
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "reason must be 3-280 characters", func() { Disqualify(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), "") })
	Disqualify(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), "commit not found")
	// re-scoring reinstates a DQ'd entry and clears the reason
	ScoreEntry(cross(cur), id, bob.String(), 5)
	e := mustEntry(mustBounty(id), bob.String())
	uassert.False(t, e.Disqualified)
	uassert.Equal(t, "", e.DQReason)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "entry not found", func() { ScoreEntry(cross(cur), id, carol.String(), 1) })
	b0 := bal(cur, bob)
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, b0+2_000_000, bal(cur, bob)) // lower is better: bob 5 beats alice 11
}

func TestAllDisqualifiedRefundsCreator(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	register(cur, alice, "alice-bot")

package bellica

import (

	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

const longText = "The creator rejected a delivery that matched the brief exactly"

// finishedJob: a direct job delivered and closed by approve (or left for release).
func finishedJob(cur realm, gv, ag address, approve bool) int {
	id := postJob(cur, gv, 2_000_000, "direct", ag.String(), "", 0, "", 0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ag))
	Accept(cross(cur), id)
	deliver(cur, ag, id)
	if approve {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(gv))
		Approve(cross(cur), id)
	}
	return id
}

func TestRateRules(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	gv, ag, outsider := testutils.TestAddress("rt-giver"), testutils.TestAddress("rt-agent"), testutils.TestAddress("rt-x")
	id := postJob(cur, gv, 2_000_000, "direct", ag.String(), "", 0, "", 0)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(gv))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only finished jobs can be rated or reported", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, ag.String(), 5, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ag))
	Accept(cross(cur), id)
	deliver(cur, ag, id)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(gv))
	Approve(cross(cur), id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only counterparties of this item can rate or report each other", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, ag.String(), 1, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(gv))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "you cannot rate or report yourself", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), 5, "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "score must be 1-5", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, ag.String(), 6, "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "kind must be job or bounty", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "gig", id, ag.String(), 5, "") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "comment must be a single line", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, ag.String(), 5, "a\nb") })
	Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, ag.String(), 5, "great **work** <b>")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "you already rated this counterparty for this item", func() { Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, ag.String(), 1, "") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ag))
	Rate(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), 4, "paid fast")
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, repOf(ag).AgentRatingN)
	uassert.Equal(t, 5, repOf(ag).AgentRatingSum)
	uassert.Equal(t, 4, repOf(gv).GiverRatingSum)
	p := Render("profile/" + ag.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(p, "great \\*\\*work\\*\\* \\<b\\>"), p)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("json/profile/"+gv.String()), `"rating_x10":40`))
}

func TestReportRules(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	gv, ag, outsider := testutils.TestAddress("rp-giver"), testutils.TestAddress("rp-agent"), testutils.TestAddress("rp-x")
	id := finishedJob(cur, gv, ag, false)
	minutes(31)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(outsider))
	Release(cross(cur), id) // creator went silent

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ag))
	ev := "https://example.com/chat.png"
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "reason must be one of non_payment_attempt, unfair_reject, unfair_dq, spam, plagiarism, other", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "rude", longText, ev)
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "text must be 30-500 characters", func() { Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "other", "too short", ev) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "text must be 30-500 characters", func() { Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "other", "                                   ", ev) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "text must explain what happened (not repeated characters)", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "other", "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "")
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "text must explain what happened (not repeated characters)", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "other", "abababababababababababababababab", "")
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "an evidence link (https or ipfs) is required for unfair_reject", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "unfair_reject", longText, "")
	})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "evidence must start with https:// or ipfs://", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "unfair_reject", longText, "javascript:alert1//x")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only counterparties of this item can rate or report each other", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "spam", longText, "")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ag))
	rid := Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "non_payment_attempt", longText, ev)
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "you already reported this counterparty for this item", func() {
		Report(cross(cur), "job", id, gv.String(), "other", longText, ev)
	})
	r := reports.Get(key(rid)).(*ReportRec)
	uassert.True(t, r.Upheld) // creator silence is an on-chain fact
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(r.Facts, "auto-release"), r.Facts)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, repOf(gv).UpheldAgainst)

	// response: only the reported party, once
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "only the reported party can respond", func() { Respond(cross(cur), rid, "I was on holiday that whole week, sorry") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(gv))
	Respond(cross(cur), rid, "I was on holiday that whole week, sorry")
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "already responded", func() { Respond(cross(cur), rid, "I was on holiday that whole week, sorry") })
	page := Render("report/" + itoa(rid))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "On-chain facts"), page)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "Upheld"), page)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("job/"+itoa(id)), "Reports on this job"))

	// a report without confirming facts is shown but not upheld
	id2 := finishedJob(cur, gv, ag, true)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(ag))
	rid2 := Report(cross(cur), "job", id2, gv.String(), "spam", "The creator keeps sending me unrelated offers", "")
	uassert.False(t, reports.Get(key(rid2)).(*ReportRec).Upheld)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, repOf(gv).UpheldAgainst)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, repOf(gv).ReportsAgainst)
}

	host, e1, e2 := testutils.TestAddress("rb-host"), testutils.TestAddress("rb-e1"), testutils.TestAddress("rb-e2")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(e2))

	uassert.True(t, reports.Get(key(rid)).(*ReportRec).Upheld)
	Rate(cross(cur), "bounty", id, host.String(), 1, "disqualified everyone")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("bounty/"+itoa(id)), "Rejected everyone"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("bounty/"+itoa(id)), "judge-scored"))

	// a fair host climbs the givers board, its winner the agents board
	host2 := testutils.TestAddress("rb-host2")

	minutes(61)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(host2))
	AcceptClaimed(cross(cur), id2)

	Rate(cross(cur), "bounty", id2, e2.String(), 5, "")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(5_000_000), repOf(host2).PaidOut)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, repOf(e2).Wins)
	gb := Render("json/leaderboard/givers")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(gb, host2.String()), gb)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(gb, host.String()), gb) // paid nothing
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("json/leaderboard/agents"), e2.String()))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("leaderboard/givers"), "Top givers"))
	// score formula: 5,000,000/1000 × 30 (unrated) × 100 / 5000 = 3000
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3000), giverScore(repOf(host2)))
}

package bellica

import (
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

// Status of a contest bounty.
const (
	StatusOpen      = "open"      // accepting entries until the deadline
	StatusJudging   = "judging"   // deadline passed, judge is scoring
	StatusPaid      = "paid"      // finalized by the judge, ranked payout sent
	StatusFallback  = "fallback"  // judge missed the window, pot split equally
	StatusRefunded  = "refunded"  // no entries, pot returned to the creator
	StatusCancelled = "cancelled" // cancelled by the creator before any entry
)

// Agent is a registered competitor (an AI agent or a human builder).
type Agent struct {
	Addr    address
	Name    string
	CardURL string // A2A agent card / homepage, optional
	Bio     string
	Joined  time.Time
	Entries int
	Podiums int   // times finished in a paid place
	Wins    int   // times finished 1st
	Earned  int64 // total ugnot won
	BestRank int  // best final rank ever (0 = never ranked)
	Ranked   int  // finished bounties where the agent was ranked
	RankSum  int  // sum of final ranks (for the average)
}

// Entry is one agent's submission to a bounty (one per agent, editable until the deadline).
type Entry struct {
	Agent        address
	RepoURL      string
	Commit       string
	Note         string
	Kind         string // deliverable kind: repo, link, image, video, file, text
	Hash         string // optional sha256 of the content
	Text         string // kind text only
	ClaimedScore int64 // score the agent reports on the published metric
	Score        int64 // score verified by the judge
	Scored       bool
	SubmittedAt  time.Time
	Rank         int   // 1-based final rank, 0 if unranked
	Payout       int64 // ugnot paid to this entry
	Disqualified bool
	DQReason     string // public reason given by the judge
}

// Bounty is a contest: many agents compete on one task, ranked by a published metric.
type Bounty struct {
	ID             int
	Title          string
	Category       string // code, design, image, video, audio, writing, data, research, other
	MinTier        int    // 0 = any agent
	SpecURL        string // task spec / eval harness
	Metric         string // e.g. "tests passed", "ms per op"
	HigherIsBetter bool
	Splits         []int // percent of the pot per place, sums to 100
	Pot            int64 // escrowed ugnot
	Creator        address
	Judge          address
	CreatedAt      time.Time
	Deadline       time.Time // submissions close
	JudgeBy        time.Time // judge must finalize before this, else fallback
	Status         string
	Paid           int64     // ugnot sent out when the bounty closed
	ClosedAt       time.Time // when it was paid / split / refunded / cancelled
	entries        *avl.Tree // agent address -> *Entry
	order          []address // submission order (tie-break: earlier wins)
	dqs            int       // disqualified entries (do not count toward the active cap)
	DQAll          bool      // self-judged and every entry disqualified (refunded to the creator)
}

// SelfJudged reports whether the creator is also the judge. A self-judged
// creator can disqualify every entry and take the pot back (each reason stays
// public), so the UI and JSON flag it (AUDIT F3).
func (b *Bounty) selfJudged() bool { return b.Judge == b.Creator }

package heirloom

import (
	"strings"

	"gno.land/p/jeronimoalbi/mdform/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"
)

func renderHome() string {
	active, gnotHeld, released := totals()

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("# Heirloom\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Leave your GNOT and tokens to the people you choose, and your admin rights in realms that check `Holder`. ")
	b.WriteString("If you show no sign of life for the period you set, anyone else can release the will and pay out your heirs' shares. ")
	b.WriteString("Until then everything stays yours. Every successful call you sign to Heirloom restarts the clock, and so does using a realm that calls `Touch`. ")
	b.WriteString("Other activity on the chain and transactions signed with a session key do not, and a session key cannot create, change or ping a will: sign those with your master key.\n\n")

	b.WriteString("| Unreleased wills | GNOT held | Wills released |\n| :---: | :---: | :---: |\n")
	b.WriteString(ufmt.Sprintf("| %d | %s | %d |\n\n", active, describe(gnot).amount(gnotHeld), released))

	b.WriteString("## Make a will\n\n")
	b.WriteString("List heirs as `address:percent`, separated by commas; the percentages must add up to 100, and the first heir gets any remainder left by rounding. ")
	b.WriteString("Your successor is whoever should inherit your admin rights in realms that check `Holder`: an heir or anyone else. Leave it empty to keep them. ")
	b.WriteString("Admin rights are handed over once, by the first released will whose successor can take them; later wills only leave assets.\n\n")
	b.WriteString(mdform.New("exec", "CreateWill").
		Input("heirs", "placeholder", "g1...:70, g1...:30", "description", "Heirs and their percentages").
		Input("silence", "type", mdform.InputTypeNumber, "value", "180", "description", ufmt.Sprintf("How many days you may stay silent, from %d to %d", int(MinSilence/day), int(MaxSilence/day))).
		Input("successor", "placeholder", "g1...", "description", "Successor (optional)").
		String() + "\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Your wills and the wills that name you as heir or successor are at `" + webPath + ":u/<your address>`.\n\n")

	if recent := recentlyReleased(); len(recent) > 0 {
		b.WriteString("## Recently released\n\n")
		for _, w := range recent {
			b.WriteString("- " + willLink(w.ID) + " of " + userLink(w.Owner) + ", " + formatTime(w.ReleasedAt) + "\n")
		}
		b.WriteString("\n")
	}

	b.WriteString("## For realm developers\n\n")
	b.WriteString("Let admin rights pass to the successor, and count every use of your realm, admin actions included, as a sign of life:\n\n")
	b.WriteString("```go\nimport \"" + pkgPath + "\"\n\n")
	b.WriteString("var admin = address(\"g1...\")\n\n")
	b.WriteString("func AdminOnly(cur realm) {\n\tif !cur.IsCurrent() || cur.Previous().Address() != heirloom.Holder(admin) {\n\t\tpanic(\"admin only\")\n\t}\n\theirloom.Touch(cross(cur))\n}\n\n")
	b.WriteString("func Use(cur realm) {\n\theirloom.Touch(cross(cur))\n}\n```\n\n")
	b.WriteString("`Touch` only vouches for the account that signed the transaction, so no realm can keep someone else's will from being released. It ignores transactions signed with a session key, so an admin who works through a session key also needs to call `Ping` now and then. ")
	b.WriteString("`Holder` returns the address itself until a released will of that address hands its admin rights on, then the holder of that successor's rights.\n")
	return b.String()
}

package heirloom

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"html"
	"math"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"
)

const ringRadius = 52

func countdownRing(w *Will) string {
	label, color, filled := "released", "#7f8c8d", 1.0
	switch w.status() {
	case statusDue:
		label, color = "due", "#c0392b"
	case statusActive:
		filled = math.Min(float64(time.Since(w.LastSeen))/float64(w.Silence), 1)
		label, color = formatDuration(time.Until(w.releaseAt()))+" left", "#27ae60"
		if filled >= 0.75 {
			color = "#d35400"
		}
	}
	circumference := 2 * math.Pi * ringRadius
	svg := ufmt.Sprintf(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="140" height="140" viewBox="0 0 140 140">`+
		`<circle cx="70" cy="70" r="%d" fill="none" stroke="#e5e5e5" stroke-width="12"/>`+
		`<circle cx="70" cy="70" r="%d" fill="none" stroke="%s" stroke-width="12" stroke-dasharray="%.1f %.1f" transform="rotate(-90 70 70)"/>`+
		`<text x="70" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="%s">%s</text></svg>`,
		ringRadius, ringRadius, color, filled*circumference, circumference, color, html.EscapeString(label))
	return "![" + label + "](data:image/svg+xml;base64," + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(svg)) + ")"
}
